Major Private-Label Product Brands
matsukiyo

Argelan (ARGELAN)

The Retinotime (THE RETINOTIME)

matsukiyo LAB
: A specialized wellness and supplement-focused line supporting preventive healthcare.
Recibe / Recipeo

Manufacturer Partners & Brand Distribution
Manufacturing and OEM Strategy
: Private-label goods are produced via contract manufacturing partnerships with leading Japanese cosmetics and pharmaceutical OEM laboratories (such as specialized domestic formulation and packaging developers), designed explicitly around in-house consumer data analytics.
External Manufacturer Partnerships
: In its retail network across Japan, Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, and Vietnam,
MatsukiyoCocokara & Co.
partners with top tier multinational and local fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) and pharmaceutical entities—distributing major names in Japanese and global cosmetics, OTC medicines, and health items (such as Shiseido, Kose, Kao, and various regional healthcare suppliers).
